exposure: gestational age at delivery (37-38 weeks, 39-41 weeks)
policy to eliminate elective early term deliveries
cohort: Singleton infants born at or after 37 weeks' gestation at a tertiary medical center from 2004 to 2015
finding: Reducing early term deliveries was associated with fewer short NICU stays, but a nonsignificant increase in the incidence of stillbirths at or after 37 to under 40 weeks.
